content: There are several avenues of future work. Since Nothman et al. 2013, more efficient methods of exploiting Wikipedia have been proposed, namely WiNER BIBREF19 , which could help increase both the quantity and quality of the training corpus. Another potential area of work is the further enrichment of the benchmark test set with additional annotation of other classes such as MISC or more fine-grained types (e.g. CITY, COUNTRY, REGION etc instead of LOC).
